prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1070; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officer responded to a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, in which the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle while both were traveling in the same lane. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was accompanied by a Passenger seated in the front passenger seat. The Passenger and Driver 2 both confirmed that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it, and two witnesses gave matching accounts. Scene photographs were taken, and the rear damage is largely consistent with the impact described. The shoulder injury Driver 1 reported fits the direction and force of a rear impact of this kind. Driver 1 produced a current insurance card listing Driver 1 as the named insured. The officer found no sign of earlier damage to the vehicle, and no one at the scene mentioned prior collisions or repairs. Driver 1 was transported for medical evaluation, and no citations were issued at the scene.
